description: Finish the session-transcript cluster cleanup: decompose entities/session/model/view.ts into per-projector files plus shared helpers, de-duplicate updateToolInTurn's merge branches, and relocate buildLiveToolDetails to the tool-views area. Pure behavior-preserving frontend refactor.

tasks.title: Decompose view.ts into per-projector files plus shared helpers
tasks.spec: specs/session-event-view/spec.md#Requirement: view.ts is decomposed into one file per projector plus a shared helpers module
tasks.description: Split entities/session/model/view.ts into view/chat.ts (buildChatView + chat-only builders like makePromptTurn, upsertToolPart, appendTextPart, KNOWN_PROMPT_KINDS, nextPartId, makeInitialTurn, closeOpenTextParts, pushErrorPart, appendReasoningPart), view/timeline.ts (buildTimelineView + timeline-local isCompactionEvent), view/compact.ts (buildCompactView), and view/helpers.ts (the >=2-projector shared utilities: narrowPayload, isRecord, getStringProp, getNumberProp, extractTextChunk, normalizeRaw, normalizeToolName, mapToolState, mapTerminalStatus, defaultToolStatus, toolRecord, readToolString, readToolValue, and the is*Event predicates). The 13 view types physically stay at the top of view.ts; the three projector files consume them via import type from '../view'. view.ts becomes a thin public entry point containing only the type declarations, the viewSessionEvents<K> dispatcher (importing the three build*View functions), and re-exports of the public surface.
acceptanceCriteria: entities/session/model/view/chat.ts, view/timeline.ts, view/compact.ts, and view/helpers.ts each exist as independent files.
buildChatView is defined in chat.ts, buildTimelineView in timeline.ts, buildCompactView in compact.ts; no projector body remains in view.ts.
Shared event-parsing helpers live in view/helpers.ts and are not duplicated across projector files; chat-only builders live only in view/chat.ts.
view.ts contains only the 13 type declarations, the kind-based viewSessionEvents dispatcher, and re-exports — no projector or helper body.

All symbols in the public surface (viewSessionEvents, SessionEvent, SessionViewKind, SessionChatPart, SessionChatTurn, SessionChatView, SessionTimelineToolCall, SessionTimelineRecovery, SessionTimelineCompaction, SessionTimelineRound, SessionTimelineView, SessionCompactView, SessionView) remain importable from entities/session/model/view with identical signatures.
widgets/coder-session/model/useSessionTimeline.ts compiles unchanged (no import-specifier edits).
entities/session/model/view.test.ts compiles and passes without modification (all 483 lines of assertions green).
npm run typecheck -w packages/web is green (no non-type import introduces a runtime circular dependency between view.ts and view/*.ts).
scc --by-file reports Complexity < 180 for each of view.ts, view/chat.ts, view/timeline.ts, view/compact.ts, and view/helpers.ts.
tasks.output: entities/session/model/view/{chat,timeline,compact,helpers}.ts created; view.ts slimmed to thin dispatcher + re-exports; all view tests and typecheck green.
tasks.notes: Follow design D1 (types stay in view.ts, projectors use import type back-imports) and D2 (helper placement boundary: a symbol is shared iff >=2 projectors reference it). Apply per-step commit discipline from the migration plan (helpers -> chat -> timeline -> compact), running typecheck+test after each extraction.

tasks.title: Collapse updateToolInTurn duplicate merge branches into a single mergeToolPart helper
tasks.spec: specs/transcript-tool-state/spec.md#Requirement: updateToolInTurn's duplicate merge branches collapse into a single merge helper
tasks.description: Inside widgets/session-transcript/model/transcript-tool-state.ts, extract one file-local mergeToolPart(toolPart, updates, now, overrideToolCallId?) helper that performs the shared field resolution (rawInput/rawOutput fallback chain, metadata/details selection, startedAt selection, getDisplayFields resolution, stringifyPayload, parseEditInput/parsePatchOperations-derived changedFiles, mapStatusToDisplay, completedAt = isTerminalState ? now : ...). updateToolInTurn becomes: find by toolCallId -> mergeToolPart(existing, updates, now); else find by correlationKey -> mergeToolPart(correlated, updates, now, incomingToolCallId); else createToolPart append. The single behavioral delta (correlation arm overwrites the matched part's toolCallId; toolCallId arm leaves it) is expressed via the optional overrideToolCallId parameter. The merge body must not appear twice.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one mergeToolPart helper performs the rawInput/rawOutput/metadata/details/display-field/status/completedAt resolution; both the toolCallId-match and correlationKey-match arms route the matched part through it.
The three-step precedence is preserved: try toolCallId, then correlationKey via findToolByCorrelation, then append via createToolPart.

The toolCallId-overwrite difference is preserved: the correlationKey arm overwrites the matched part's toolCallId with the incoming one, the toolCallId arm leaves the matched part's existing toolCallId — parameterized via overrideToolCallId, not by duplicating the merge body.
Field-resolution order, stringifyPayload application, changedFiles derivation, mapStatusToDisplay mapping (including timeout->failed), and completedAt set to now iff terminal are all unchanged.

The complete public surface (updateToolInTurn, createToolPart, mapStatusToDisplay, isTerminalState, findToolByCorrelation, deriveToolTarget, getDisplayFields, getNormalizedName, LiveToolCall) remains importable from ./transcript-tool-state with identical signatures.
widgets/session-transcript/model/transcript-state.test.ts compiles and passes without modification — the toolCallId-match, correlationKey-match, and append-new scenarios are invariant field by field.
npm run typecheck -w packages/web is green.
mergeToolPart receives now as a parameter rather than calling new Date() itself, keeping the helper pure and the existing test timing pattern undisturbed.
tasks.output: widgets/session-transcript/model/transcript-tool-state.ts with updateToolInTurn de-duplicated via mergeToolPart; transcript-state tests and typecheck green.
tasks.notes: Follow design D3. The now parameter is passed in (not new Date() inside the helper) so transcript-state.test.ts's completedAt-presence assertions are undisturbed. This task only touches the merge logic; buildLiveToolDetails stays in place and is relocated in T-003.

tasks.title: Relocate buildLiveToolDetails to the tool-views area
tasks.spec: specs/transcript-tool-state/spec.md#Requirement: buildLiveToolDetails relocates out of the state-transition module to the tool-views area
tasks.description: Move the buildLiveToolDetails tool-family dispatcher (the bash/shell/exec/command, task, skill, question/webfetch/websearch, and todowrite/todo branches) out of widgets/session-transcript/model/transcript-tool-state.ts into a new widgets/session-transcript/ui/tool-views/live-details.ts module, co-locating it with the existing tool-family rendering logic (alongside shared.tsx). Update its internal imports of asPayloadRecord/asRecord/getNumber/getString/truncatePreview from ./transcript-payload to the new relative path ../../model/transcript-payload. Add `export { buildLiveToolDetails } from '../../ui/tool-views/live-details'` to transcript-tool-state.ts so transcript-state.ts's import specifier ./transcript-tool-state keeps resolving every symbol it uses today unchanged. After the move, transcript-tool-state.ts contains only turn/part state-transition logic plus the re-export.
acceptanceCriteria: buildLiveToolDetails is defined in widgets/session-transcript/ui/tool-views/live-details.ts and its dispatcher body is no longer present in transcript-tool-state.ts.

transcript-tool-state.ts contains only turn/part state-transition logic (updateToolInTurn, createToolPart, mapStatusToDisplay, isTerminalState, findToolByCorrelation, deriveToolTarget, getDisplayFields, getNormalizedName) plus the buildLiveToolDetails re-export.
buildLiveToolDetails remains importable from widgets/session-transcript/model/transcript-tool-state via re-export, so transcript-state.ts requires zero import-specifier changes.

The details records per tool family are unchanged field by field: execution (command/cwd/timeout/exitCode/outputPreview/completionStatus with truncatePreview truncation), delegation (description/subagentType/subagentName/taskId/childSessionId), skill (skillName), interaction (url/query/answerCount/resultPreview with the 300-character cap), planning (totalCount/statusCounts), and undefined for unknown families.
widgets/session-transcript/model/transcript-state.test.ts compiles and passes without modification — every buildLiveToolDetails family assertion is invariant.
useSessionTranscript.ts compiles unchanged (its ./transcript-state imports still resolve buildLiveToolDetails transitively).
npm run typecheck -w packages/web is green.
scc --by-file reports Complexity < 180 for widgets/session-transcript/model/transcript-tool-state.ts (down from the C=180 baseline once both the de-duplication from T-002 and this relocation land).
tasks.output: widgets/session-transcript/ui/tool-views/live-details.ts created with buildLiveToolDetails; transcript-tool-state.ts slimmed to state-transition logic + re-export; transcript-state tests and typecheck green.
tasks.notes: Follow design D4. Depends on T-002 because both tasks edit transcript-tool-state.ts — T-002 modifies updateToolInTurn in place and T-003 removes buildLiveToolDetails and adds the re-export line, so applying T-003 on top of T-002's result avoids a conflicting edit. The only importer of buildLiveToolDetails is transcript-state.ts (confirmed by grep), so the re-export is belt-and-suspenders.
